paper_title: Constraints on dark photon dark matter from Lyman-$α$ forest simulations and an ultra-high signal-to-noise quasar spectrum
notes: Cosmological/astrophysical bound on dark photon DM kinetic mixing from Lyman-alpha forest heating (VLT/UVES quasar HE0940-1050 + hydro simulations). 95% CL limits shown in Fig. 7 vs dark photon mass. Constraints only apply to intermediate masses (log10(mA'/eV) between about -13.15 and -12.40); low-mass (-13.4) and high-mass (>=-12.15) models are unconstrained within the simulated parameter grid. Numerical epsilon values estimated from figures (no data table given); masses converted from log10(mA'/eV c^-2). DM assumed to be entirely dark photons but this is not a haloscope so no local density assumed. Best-fit model of Ref[41] (mA'=8e-14 eV, eps=5e-15) is allowed at 95% CL. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 3, 0, 0.5, 4))
